note: Autoclave/edge cures (ops 110/140/190) are IFS MACH_RUN-sourced, not WI-timed; the validator sets those aside. WI-extractable cures below are the Epocast ring bond + sealer/primer/topcoat dries.

cures.label: Ring bond Epocast 1636 min 12hr RT cure
cures.source_quote: Cut the Epocast about 1/8" (.125) above the skin with the Sawzall and sand

cures.label: Epoxy sealer (MIL-C-22750) bake/dry; primer within 6hr
cures.source_quote: DURING APPLICATION OF THE EPOXY SEALER COAT, TEMPERATURE SHALL BE MAINTAINED BETWEEN 50 AND 95F

cures.label: Primer flash + dry-to-recoat before topcoat
cures.source_quote: Reduce primer with 6-8 ounces of thinner per MIL-T-81772, type II

cures.label: GATE — Topcoat 24hr cure before finish insp / paint-adhesion
cures.source_quote: Reduce mixed topcoat to a viscosity of 20-40 seconds in a #2 Zahn cup
